At Elite Plates, we are committed to protecting your privacy and handling your personal information securely and responsibly.

This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, and protect your information when you use our website or contact us through our social media platforms.

Information We Collect

When placing an order or contacting us, we may collect information including:

* Name
* Email address
* Delivery and billing address
* Phone number
* Vehicle registration details provided for custom orders
* Social media usernames where supplied for contact purposes

We may also collect limited technical information such as IP address, browser type, and website activity through cookies and analytics tools.


How We Use Your Information

Your information is used to:

* Process and fulfil orders
* Provide customer support
* Contact you regarding your order where necessary
* Improve our website, products, and customer experience
* Prevent fraudulent activity and maintain website security

We will never sell or share your personal information with third parties for marketing purposes.

Payments

All payments are processed securely through trusted third-party payment providers. Elite Plates does not store or have access to your full payment card details.


Marketing & Analytics

Our website may use cookies, analytics, and advertising tools provided by services such as Shopify, Meta (Facebook & Instagram), TikTok, and Google to help improve performance, advertising, and user experience.

These tools may collect limited browsing and interaction data.


Data Protection

We take reasonable steps to ensure your information is stored securely and protected against unauthorised access, misuse, or disclosure.


Your Rights

You have the right to request access to the personal information we hold about you and request corrections or deletion where applicable.

For any privacy-related enquiries, please contact us using the details below.

Contact Us

If you have any questions regarding this Privacy Policy or your personal information, please contact us:

Email:
eliteplates2@gmail.com

Instagram:
https://www.instagram.com/eliteplatesuk

Facebook:
https://www.facebook.com/eliteplatesuk

By using our website, you agree to the terms outlined within this Privacy Policy.
